i.norm: Verifies that a negative nano adjustment wraps into the previous second, and that isAfter() correctly returns false when the instant is earlier than the reference. TaiInstant.ofTaiSeconds(883, -784) normalises the negative nano adjustment: seconds = 883 + floorDiv(-784, 1_000_000_000) = 883 + (-1) = 882 nanos = floorMod(-784, 1_000_000_000) = 999_999_216
Reference instant at exactly one day (86400 s) into the TAI epoch
Instant created with a negative nano adjustment; the factory normalises it so that nanos is always in [0, 999_999_999]. -784 ns wraps: seconds becomes 882, nanos becomes 999_999_216.
882 seconds is far earlier than 86400 seconds, so isAfter must be false
